entries.canonical_text: Vogue's wider list of bags Vogue, also covering the 2026 season, showed not only small pouches from Prada and Loewe, but also Celine's Ultra Maxi, Altuzarra's large shoulder bag, and roomy totes from Toteme and other brands. This lineup matters. large bags had not vanished. Small and large bags were appearing in the same season. What we see here is not mini bags spreading across the whole market, but their return in fashion coverage and on selected runways. Even so, the way trends look has changed. Bags are no longer in a game where one size alone sits on the throne. Large bags are the luggage crew, carrying what we need. Mini bags are the stage crew, drawing the eye and setting the mood. In 2026, the runway is proudly showing this division of labor.
